title: tragiopsis involucrata
intro: Tragiopsis involucrata, commonly known as the 'Thai angel's trumpet', is a flowering plant species native to Southeast Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The plant is known to offer health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels. The bioactive constituents of Tragiopsis involucrata include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardiovascular protective effects.
